title: Sarcopenia and physical-function research
population: Prefrailty and exercise studies summarized in a review
endpoint: Walking speed, strength and training response

certainty.label: Not appraised
certainty.rationale: A body-of-evidence certainty method and its required domains have not been completed and independently reviewed. This label is not a Low-certainty grade.

magnitudeClass.label: Not classified
magnitudeClass.reason: No prespecified clinical-importance thresholds have been applied; inspect the reported estimate and interval.

finding.text: The review describes mixed physical-function findings, including a walking-speed signal, null strength outcomes and attenuated exercise responses.

limitations.text: Few included trials specifically recruited people with sarcopenia, and exercise trials tested metformin alongside training.
The review predates the 2025 MET-PREVENT trial.

pending: Reconcile populations, exercise co-interventions and outcomes

magnitudeText: The review summarizes walking speed, strength and exercise responses across different studies.
evidenceBase: A 2023 narrative review of metformin and physical function.
